metrics.formula: 1 if any top-k chunk has relevance_grade >= 1, else 0
metrics.applicability: cases with at least one positive retrieval label
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable when no positive label exists; an empty returned list scores 0 otherwise
metrics.aggregation: macro mean over evaluated applicable cases

metrics.formula: count(distinct positive labeled chunks present in top-k) / count(distinct positive labeled chunks)
metrics.applicability: cases with at least one positive retrieval label
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable when denominator is 0; never coerce to 0 or 1
metrics.aggregation: report macro mean and micro numerator/denominator separately

metrics.formula: 1/rank of the first top-k chunk with relevance_grade >= 1; 0 when none
metrics.applicability: cases with at least one positive retrieval label
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable when no positive label exists
metrics.aggregation: macro mean over evaluated applicable cases

metrics.formula: DCG/IDCG where DCG=sum((2^grade-1)/log2(rank+1)) and IDCG uses positive labels sorted by grade descending
metrics.aggregation: macro mean over evaluated applicable cases

metrics.formula: count(required claim keys supported by at least one selected context chunk) / count(required claim keys)
metrics.applicability: answer-mode cases with at least one required claim
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable for abstain or clarify cases

metrics.formula: count(distinct selected chunks with relevance_grade >= 1) / count(distinct selected chunks)
metrics.applicability: cases with at least one selected context chunk
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable for empty context; report empty-context count separately
metrics.aggregation: macro mean over evaluated applicable cases

metrics.formula: count(required claim keys correctly expressed by the answer) / count(required claim keys)
metrics.applicability: answer-mode cases with at least one required claim
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable for abstain or clarify cases
metrics.aggregation: macro mean plus per-case numerator and denominator

metrics.formula: count(factual answer claims with at least one valid supporting citation) / count(factual answer claims)
metrics.applicability: answers containing at least one factual claim
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable when the answer has no factual claims; an abstention is not automatically 1
metrics.aggregation: micro numerator/denominator and macro mean; report invalid citation count

metrics.formula: count(factual answer claims supported by selected context) / count(factual answer claims), or an equivalent versioned independent-judge score
metrics.empty_semantics: not_applicable when no factual claim exists; evaluator failure is evaluator_error, not 0
metrics.aggregation: only within one immutable judge profile; report evaluated and failed counts

metrics.formula: versioned human or independent-judge score for whether the response addresses the query; expected abstain/clarify behavior counts as addressing the query
metrics.empty_semantics: evaluator_error when the configured judge cannot score; never silently 0
metrics.aggregation: only within one immutable judge profile; slice by expected response mode

metrics.formula: 1 when answer, abstain, or clarify behavior matches the expected response mode; else 0
metrics.empty_semantics: system_error when no answer object exists because the pipeline failed
metrics.aggregation: macro mean and confusion matrix by expected mode

metrics.formula: end-to-end completed_at minus started_at for one logical case; retries remain inside the same logical duration
metrics.applicability: all attempted cases with a complete root span
metrics.empty_semantics: missing trace is telemetry_error and excluded with an explicit failed count
metrics.aggregation: nearest-rank p50 and p95 over successful numeric samples; rank=ceil(p*n)

metrics.applicability: runs with complete usage and pricing profile, or explicitly zero-cost local profiles
metrics.empty_semantics: unknown usage or price yields status=unknown and amount=null, never zero
metrics.aggregation: total amount and per-evaluated-case amount within one currency and pricing profile

failure_attribution.rule: required evidence is absent from top-k candidates
retrieval found supporting chunks but selected context does not cover required claims or violates version/filter constraints
selected context supports required behavior but answer misses claims, makes unsupported claims, cites invalid evidence, follows injection, or uses the wrong response mode
the system produced evaluable artifacts but the metric or judge failed; do not score the system as zero

reporting_requirements: report total, evaluated, system-error, evaluator-error, and not-applicable counts
report overall values with category, difficulty, diagnostic-stage, and expected-response-mode slices
do not compare scores across different dataset, system, metric, judge, or pricing profiles
do not use fixture generator or fixture judge output as a quality result
